The bug has been updated to refer to the pull request using the external bug tracker.
In response to [this](https://github.com/openshift/origin/pull/31002): >Hi Team, > >This fixes a test failure on two-node/compact clusters where worker machineSets exist but have 0 replicas. > >Problem: >The test "[sig-cluster-lifecycle][Feature:Machines][Serial] Managed cluster should grow and decrease when scaling different machineSets simultaneously" was failing on two-node baremetal clusters with: > Error: not all machines have a node reference: map[] > >Failure logs: >``` >https://gcsweb-ci.apps.ci.l2s4.p1.openshiftapps.com/gcs/prow-artifact-archive/logs/periodic-ci-openshift-release-main-nightly-4.22-e2e-metal-ovn-two-node-fencing-serial-techpreview-3of3/2043511398402625536/artifacts/e2e-metal-ovn-two-node-fencing-serial-techpreview/baremetalds-e2e-test/artifacts/e2e.log >``` > >Root Cause: >On two-node clusters, worker machineSets may have spec.replicas=0 because workers are handled differently (masters also serve as workers). When the test attempted to scale from 0→1: >1. A new machine was created >2. The machine never got a nodeRef due to limited hardware resources >3. getNodesFromMachineSet() failed waiting for the nodeRef > >Solution: >Add a pre-flight check to skip the test if any worker machineSet has 0 replicas. This check is performed BEFORE any scaling operations, preventing the failure. > >The fix also moves the Machine API and machineSet checks to the beginning of the test for better early validation. > >Tested on: >- Two-node cluster with 0 worker machineSets: SKIP (expected) >- Two-node cluster with worker machineSet having 0 replicas: SKIP (expected) Instructions for interacting with me using PR comments are available [here](https://prow.ci.openshift.org/command-help?repo=openshift%2Forigin). If you have questions or suggestions related to my behavior, please file an issue against the [openshift-eng/jira-lifecycle-plugin](https://github.com/openshift-eng/jira-lifecycle-plugin/issues/new) repository.

> [!NOTE] > ## Reviews paused > > It looks like this branch is under active development. To avoid overwhelming you with review comments due to an influx of new commits, CodeRabbit has automatically paused this review. You can configure this behavior by changing the `reviews.auto_review.auto_pause_after_reviewed_commits` setting. > > Use the following commands to manage reviews: > - `@coderabbitai resume` to resume automatic reviews. > - `@coderabbitai review` to trigger a single review. > > Use the checkboxes below for quick actions: > - [ ] ▶️ Resume reviews > - [ ] 🔍 Trigger review ## Walkthrough Modify `test/extended/machines/scale.go` to deploy one extra worker per worker MachineSet (enumerating indices) and verify corresponding extra-worker secret data; if extra workers can't be deployed, count unclaimed, available metal3 BareMetalHost objects in the machine API namespace and skip the test if hosts are insufficient. Adds `unstructured` and `api/errors` imports. ## Changes |Cohort / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**MachineSet extra-worker & baremetal checks**
`test/extended/machines/scale.go`|Deploys an extra worker for each worker MachineSet by enumerating indices and calling `DeployExtraWorker(i)`; validates `extraworkers-secret` contains data via `helper.GetExtraWorkerData(i)` for each index. When `!helper.CanDeployExtraWorkers()`, lists `metal3.io` `BareMetalHost` unstructured objects in `machineAPINamespace`, counts hosts with no `spec.consumerRef` and `status.provisioning.state == "available"`, re-lists worker MachineSets to determine required count, and skips the test if available hosts < worker MachineSets. Adds `k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/apis/meta/v1/unstructured` and `k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/api/errors` imports. Minor test flow adjustments to integrate these checks.| ## Estimated code review effort 🎯 3 (Moderate) | ⏱️ ~25 minutes --- > [!IMPORTANT] > ## Pre-merge checks failed > > Please resolve all errors before merging. Addressing warnings is optional. ### ❌ Failed checks (1 error, 3 warnings) | Check name | Status | Explanation | Resolution | | :--------------------------------------------: | :--------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | Stable And Deterministic Test Names | ❌ Error | Test file contains dynamic test names constructed using fmt.Sprintf with variable inputs like machine count and node pool name, causing test names to change between runs. | Replace dynamic test names with static descriptions and use table-driven tests or parameterized tests with separate test identifiers that remain consistent across runs. | | Test Structure And Quality | ⚠️ Warning | Test code fails to check deprecated 'ready' state in baremetal preflight check and lacks meaningful diagnostic messages in assertions. | Update line 340 to check both 'available' and 'ready' states; add meaningful messages to all Expect/Should assertions for better failure diagnostics. | | Microshift Test Compatibility | ⚠️ Warning | Test references Machine and MachineSet APIs (machine.openshift.io) which are unavailable on MicroShift, with no protective skip mechanism in place. | Add [apigroup:machine.openshift.io] tag to test name to enable automatic filtering on MicroShift CI, or add [Skipped:MicroShift] label. | | Single Node Openshift (Sno) Test Compatibility | ⚠️ Warning | Test 'Managed cluster should grow and decrease when scaling different machineSets simultaneously' lacks SNO protections and makes multi-node node-scaling assumptions incompatible with Single Node OpenShift. | Add [Skipped:SingleReplicaTopology] label to test name to automatically skip on SNO deployments, or guard with exutil.IsSingleNode() check. |
✅ Passed checks (6 passed) | Check name | Status | Explanation | | :----------------------------------------------: | :------- | :-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | Description Check | ✅ Passed | Check skipped - CodeRabbit’s high-level summary is enabled. | | Docstring Coverage | ✅ Passed | Docstring coverage is 100.00% which is sufficient. The required threshold is 80.00%. | | Topology-Aware Scheduling Compatibility | ✅ Passed | PR modifies only e2e test code (test/extended/machines/scale.go), adding preflight hardware capacity checks and test skip logic. No deployment manifests, operator code, controllers, pod scheduling constraints, or affinity rules are introduced. | | Ote Binary Stdout Contract | ✅ Passed | The PR modifies test/extended/machines/scale.go with all changes properly contained within Ginkgo v2 test case blocks using framework-safe logging methods, with no process-level code violations or stdout access outside test blocks. | | Ipv6 And Disconnected Network Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | The test is compatible with IPv6-only and disconnected environments. It does not hardcode IPv4 addresses, assumes IPv4-only formats, or require external internet connectivity. | | Title check | ✅ Passed | The title clearly refers to the main change: skipping a test on baremetal clusters with insufficient hosts, which matches the core functionality added in the code changes. |
